data.name: ChangelogBody
data.value: • 0.2.26 — Scans can't stall the UI anymore: 60-second cap with a clear message, and the handle counter moves again. • 0.2.25 — No more multi-second scan freezes: parallel name lookups, owner lookup only for matches. • 0.2.24 — Scan log shows elapsed time, to tell slow AV filters apart from stalls. • 0.2.23 — Eject names hidden blockers too: protected programs (e.g. antivirus) and deep rescan. • 0.2.22 — Fixed mixed languages: every window now follows the selected UI language. • 0.2.21 — Wait cursor while ejecting; changelog follows the UI language. • 0.2.20 — Changelog menu (this list). • 0.2.19 — Blocked-eject dialog names the exact programs, red icon, step-by-step remedy. • 0.2.18 — Automatic on-demand elevation; UI always runs as standard user, drag and drop always works. • 0.2.17 — Starts as standard user, no UAC prompt at launch. • 0.2.16 — Admin/User switch, paste from clipboard. • 0.2.15 — Configurable scan timeout (50–500 ms). • 0.2.14 — Eject veto reasons fully translated. • 0.2.13 — Dedicated dialog for failed ejection. • 0.2.12 — Correct veto codes and friendly device names. • 0.2.11 / 0.2.10 — Sharp About icon. • 0.2.9 / 0.2.8 / 0.2.7 / 0.2.6 — Program Files install, versioned setup, post-install launch. • 0.2.5 — Tagline and About dialog with big icon. • 0.2.4 — Warning when drag and drop is blocked (elevated). • 0.2.3 — Full-width strings fixed in every language. • 0.2.2 — Sources and docs in English. • 0.2.1 — Drag and drop onto the file field. • 0.2.0 — Safe eject, Access column, CSV/TSV export, USB auto-refresh, log. • 0.1.5 — Draggable splitter, vector icons, scan animations. • 0.1.4 — UNC and mapped-drive paths supported. • 0.1.3 — Audit fixes, F5 refresh, works as non-admin. • 0.1.2 — Fast robust scan (handle64-style engine). • 0.1.1 — External USB SSD detection. • 0.1.0 — First base: per-drive locks, file check, EFIGS, Fluent style.
